system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: volcanic temples and the hottest regions of the Plane of Fire. Heart of ash is a charcoal-black seed found at the centre of a rare fire-tree after its trunk has burned completely away. It beats faintly when held near flame and opens along glowing red seams when exposed to volcanic heat. The seed is ground into a dense black draught that burns like molten metal going down, though it leaves the drinker unmarked. For 10 minutes, you gain immunity to fire damage and treat extreme environmental heat as one severity lower. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.

effects.text: Treat extreme environmental heat as one severity lower.
